title: Long-Standing Member Guarantee Uplift Schedule
content:
| Whole months from the date the membership was opened to the claim | Long-standing member guarantee uplift |
|---|---|
| 84 or more | 3.00 dollars |
| 36 to 83 | 1.50 dollars |
| fewer than 36 | nothing |

**Rule.** On Northgate Memberships a membership opened 84 or more whole months before the claim adds a long-standing member guarantee uplift of 3.00 dollars, one opened 36 to 83 whole months before adds 1.50 dollars, and one opened fewer than 36 whole months before adds nothing. The uplift is added to the guarantee refund of a year that shows a guarantee shortfall; a year without a guarantee shortfall pays nothing.

**Counting.** Whole calendar months from the opening date shown on the membership to the date of the claim; a month counts only when the claim date's day of the month has reached the opening date's day of the month. The opening date is the date the membership was first purchased.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Opened | Claim | Whole months | Uplift |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 February 2020 | 19 February 2027 | 83 | 1.50 |
| 20 February 2020 | 20 February 2027 | 84 | 3.00 |
| 20 February 2024 | 19 February 2027 | 35 | nothing |
| 20 February 2024 | 20 February 2027 | 36 | 1.50 |
